title: First, understand the question
intro: A good answer begins with the right question. Find the
onTopic: A school garden helps students learn about plants.
offTopic: My grandmother has a beautiful garden at home.
helpVi: Đề yêu cầu nêu quan điểm và giải thích về khu vườn nhỏ ở trường.

analysis.title: See the answer shape before you try
analysis.note: Use short phrases here. You are analysing the question, not writing the paragraph yet.
analysis.samplePrompt: Some students think schools should have a weekly reading hour. Do you agree? Give reasons and an example.

rows.label: Topic
rows.example: a weekly reading hour at school
rows.why: Name what the question is about. Do not copy the whole prompt.

rows.label: Task
rows.example: state my opinion + give reasons + give an example
rows.why: List everything the writer must do.

rows.label: Important words
rows.example: schools, reading hour, agree, reasons, example
rows.why: Keep the words that control the answer.

rows.label: Limit / scope
rows.example: reading at school and its value for students
rows.why: Say what must stay inside the answer.

rows.label: Avoid
rows.example: home reading habits or an unrelated book review
rows.why: Notice what would take the answer away from the prompt.

analysis.noteVi: Ở bước này chỉ cần cụm từ ngắn. Đây là phân tích đề, chưa phải viết đoạn văn.

brainstorm.title: Turn the question into useful ideas
brainstorm.note: Notes are enough. You do not need perfect grammar yet; focus on relevant ideas and one concrete example.
brainstorm.samplePrompt: Should schools have a weekly reading hour?

rows.label: My ideas
rows.example: quiet reading; learn new words; share books
rows.why: Generate several possible reasons before choosing.

rows.label: Best main idea
rows.example: Students can build a regular reading habit.
rows.why: Choose the idea you can explain most clearly.

rows.label: Why is it true?
rows.example: They get protected time to read every week.
rows.why: Explain the reason instead of only naming it.

rows.label: A real example
rows.example: For example, a class could read for 20 minutes every Friday.
rows.why: Make the idea concrete and easy to understand.

brainstorm.noteVi: Ghi ý ngắn là đủ. Chưa cần ngữ pháp hoàn hảo; hãy tập trung vào ý liên quan và một ví dụ cụ thể.

outline.title: Build the paragraph before writing it
outline.note: An outline is a map. Full sentences are helpful for the opening and ending; the middle can still be short notes.
outline.samplePrompt: Should schools have a weekly reading hour?

rows.label: Opening
rows.example: I think schools should have a weekly reading hour.

rows.label: Reason
rows.example: It helps students build a reading habit.
rows.why: Give the main support for your opinion.

rows.label: Supporting detail
rows.example: Regular practice can make reading feel easier.

rows.label: Example
rows.example: For example, each class could read for 20 minutes on Friday.
rows.why: Connect the reason to a real situation.

rows.label: Ending
rows.example: A regular reading hour would make reading part of school life.
rows.why: Finish by returning to the main point.

outline.noteVi: Dàn ý là bản đồ của đoạn văn. Mở bài và kết bài nên là câu hoàn chỉnh; các ý giữa có thể vẫn là ghi chú ngắn.
